### vpc-peering-accept-not-own-request

**Claim.** You cannot accept a peering request that you sent to another AWS account; within one account you can create and accept the request yourself.

**Write it as.** `can't accept a VPC peering connection request`

**Scope.** VPC peering connection request.

> "You can't accept a VPC peering connection request that you sent to another AWS account. To create a VPC peering connection between VPCs in the same AWS account, you can both create and accept the request yourself."
> — [Accept or reject a VPC peering connection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/accept-vpc-peering-connection.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-14.

### vpc-peering-accept-only-trusted-accounts

**Claim.** Do not accept VPC peering connection requests from unknown AWS accounts: a malicious user may send a request to gain unauthorized network access to your VPC, which is known as peer phishing; you can safely reject unwanted VPC peering connection requests without any risk of the requester gaining access to information about your account or VPC.

**Write it as.** `peer phishing` · `reject unwanted VPC peering connection requests`

**Scope.** VPC peering connection request.

> "Do not accept VPC peering connections from unknown AWS accounts. A malicious user may have sent you a VPC peering connection request to gain unauthorized network access to your VPC. This is known as peer phishing. You can safely reject unwanted VPC peering connection requests without any risk of the requester gaining access to any information about your AWS account or your VPC."
> — [Accept or reject a VPC peering connection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/accept-vpc-peering-connection.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-14.

### vpc-peering-config-entire-vpc-route

**Claim.** With a route to the entire peer VPC, any resource in one VPC can communicate with any resource in the peer VPC and management is simpler, but all traffic between the VPCs flows through the peering connection.

**Write it as.** `simplifying management` · `any resource in one VPC to communicate`

**Scope.** VPC peering route configuration.

> "In this configuration, you create a route in each VPC's route table that sends all traffic destined for the peer VPC to the VPC peering connection. This allows any resource in one VPC to communicate with any resource in the peer VPC, simplifying management. However, it also means that all traffic between the VPCs will flow through the peering connection, which could become a bottleneck if the traffic volume is high."
> — [Common VPC peering connection configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/peering-configurations.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-14.

### vpc-peering-config-specific-routes

**Claim.** With specific routes, you send only traffic for particular subnets or resources of the peer VPC through the peering connection, which limits traffic to what is necessary but needs more maintenance when resources are added.

**Write it as.** `more granular routes` · `requires more maintenance`

**Scope.** VPC peering route configuration.

> "Alternatively, you can create more granular routes in each VPC's route table that only send traffic to specific subnets or resources in the peer VPC. This allows you to limit the traffic flowing through the peering connection to only what is necessary, which can be more efficient. However, it also requires more maintenance, as you'll need to update the route tables any time you add new resources in the peer VPC that need to communicate."
> — [Common VPC peering connection configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/peering-configurations.html)

### vpc-peering-wp-use-tgw-or-cloud-wan-as-hub

**Claim.** To let all VPCs talk to each other with VPC peering you need 1:1 peering connections between each pair; alternatively you can use AWS Transit Gateway or AWS Cloud WAN as a network transit hub.

**Write it as.** `create 1:1 VPC peering connections between each of them` · `AWS Transit Gateway or AWS Cloud WAN`

**Scope.** VPC peering design.

Alternatively, you can use AWS Transit Gateway or AWS Cloud WAN to act as a network transit hub."
